title: Archival verification receipt
description: Extends frame-receipt-v1 — this declares only what documentary evidence adds. The field to read is `independence`: how many sources agreed, and how many were left after the chains were followed home. The gap between those two numbers is the whole of what this pack contributes.

documentary.description: Always true. It is the flag that stops a documentary receipt being read alongside a computational one as though they were the same kind of evidence.

supports_status.description: What this receipt establishes. Null unless the verdict is a pass — a check that failed or did not run supports nothing.

independence.description: The collapse: supporting sources in, distinct origins out, and which sources folded into which chain.
